# Pricing restructure — retire the legacy starter plan

## Context
Support load from the legacy starter plan is high (35% of tickets). Need to move users to current plans.

## Decision
Retire the legacy starter plan. New signups start on the Basic plan.

## Rationale
- Starter users file 35% of tickets vs 15% for Basic
- Revenue impact is minimal (starter is only 19% of revenue)
- Reduces support burden
